words.gloss: one who is easy to defeat

literal: One who fears, knows not, harmony has not, gives not, is easily vulnerable to enemies.
translation: One who is fearful, ignorant, lacking in social harmony, and miserly, becomes an extremely easy prey for his enemies.
modern: அச்சப்படுபவனும், அறிவில்லாதவனும், பிறருடன் இணங்கிப் போகாதவனும், கொடைத்தன்மை இல்லாதவனும் ஆகிய ஒருவன், தன் பகைவர்க்கு மிக எளிதில் தோற்றுப் போகக்கூடியவன் ஆவான்.
explanation: This couplet outlines four fatal flaws that make a person highly vulnerable to their enemies. First, fearfulness prevents them from taking bold action. Second, ignorance deprives them of strategic wisdom. Third, a lack of harmony or adaptability isolates them from potential allies. Fourth, miserliness ensures they have no loyal supporters. Together, these traits make such a person an incredibly easy target for any adversary.
